verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page lists 'Custom ring orders', call transfers and phone menus, and the homepage claims it routes incoming calls to the right person on a shared number. Missed calls produce voicemail transcripts, so voicemail capture exists. These are thin marketing mentions with no documentation of ring-group behavior or unanswered-call fallback. missing for 10: explicit simultaneous-ring option, documented sequential ring-group configuration, unanswered-call forwarding to another number, configuration docs and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can ring a group in order or simultaneously, and route unanswered calls to voicemail or another number

citations.quote: Custom ring orders ... Call transfers ... Phone menus
